topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation and outlines what will be covered.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition via molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system senses pathogens and cellular damage through PAMPs, DAMPs, and various pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Inflammatory responses: sentinel cell activation, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the cellular events of inflammation, including sentinel cell mediator release, leukocyte recruitment into tissues, lymphatic drainage, and systemic complications like sepsis.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the passive and active mechanisms that terminate inflammation, drive tissue repair, and lead to chronic inflammation or granuloma formation when resolution is incomplete.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer wraps up the lecture and announces the upcoming topic.
